_comment: Deterministic skeleton for REVIEW_AGENT_ASSESSMENT.json. The reviewer agent MUST copy this file verbatim into the per-run scratch path, then fill in the values. Every required field name, casing, and enum value is part of the contract — do not rename, lowercase, or omit. The deterministic review finalizer refuses any assessment that does not validate against this shape.
reviewer_head_before: <fill: same value as candidate_sha_claimed; if it differs, emit STALE_CANDIDATE>
reviewer_head_after: <fill: same value as candidate_sha_claimed; if it differs, BLOCK with the changed paths>
packet_sha256_recomputed: <fill: recompute sha256 of WORK_PACKET.md bytes; must equal approval.packet_sha256>
_recommended_verdict_enum: Must be exactly one of: APPROVED | CHANGES_REQUESTED | BLOCKED | HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED | STALE_CANDIDATE — UPPERCASE, no quotes mismatch.
